skillFull: Melon Soft Sere shows up at certain intervals. The pet flies forward towards the ice cream, licking it until it becomes a perfectly-shaped Melon Soft Serve Jelly. Level Up for more points for Melon Soft Serve Jellies.
story: One day, Melon Mlem just pop, pop, POP!-ed out from between the rippling waves of Bluefizz Beach, where it stopped right in front of Melon Soda Cookie excitedly exploring the City when she first arrived and teasingly sticking its tongue out at her. Whether it was the excitement, the playful nature, or something else—Melon Soda Cookie immediately saw something in Melon Mlem that she saw in herself and took it on as her first real friend in Platter City. Ever since, Melon Mlem has busied itself, pop, pop, POP!-ing its way around Cafe Fruit Bomber, sticking right by the Cookie's side. It gets particularly poppy whenever a Cookie decides to take pictures—hopping around at a speed that makes it hard to get a clear shot! Every unfocused picture with Melon Mlem hopping around sends both the Cookie and Pet into an endless fit of giggles, so it doesn't seem to bother them all that much. Having a friend you can trust and rely on is what really counts when you're starting off somewhere new!

costumes.name: Summer Dancer
costumes.info: Melon Mlem jumped right in to help promote Cafe Fruit Bomber's new watermelon punch! Topped with a dollop of cream and a slice of watermelon, it bounces and dances its way between the Cookies to hype them up... It may not have a sense of rhythm, but who cares as long as it looks like its having fun!
